$comment: The house base (slice 2c of docs/features/directed-performance.md): every value that shapes it, so the base is re-made by `house-base.ts`, never edited by hand. The look follows the owner's pick, soft clay (2026-11-18), from Astra's `clay-turnaround.png`, `base-finishes.png` and `clay-traits.png`; colours are linear, converted from sRGB read off the sheets' lit midtones (`sheetSRGB`). What the build cannot match is in the brief's 2c evidence.
name: house-base

proportions.$comment: Scales about a pivot, weighted by the MPFB mixamo weights of the bones named, so the rig is fitted to the scaled mesh and no bone is ever scaled. head: about the neck joint; hands: about the wrist.

rig.$comment: thumbBase: where the thumb's base joint sits, in hand lengths (wrist to middle knuckle) from the wrist: along the wrist-to-middle-knuckle line, toward the index side, out of the palm's plane on the thumb's side. Read from the tracked hands of capture's hand replays (headset 0.39, 0.24, 0.20; IWER 0.38, 0.26, 0.18; 2026-11-20). MPFB's mixamo rig has it in the plane (0.41, 0.25, 0.00), which the replay counted as 20 to 27 degrees of thumb curl error (bar 15).

fit.$comment: The fit (slice 2c2, fit.py): the MPFB human, proportioned, is moved onto `target`, a visual hull carved by carve.py from clay-turnaround.png's silhouettes alone (no generator, no third-party weights: the owner's licence decision of 2026-11-19 retired the Hunyuan3D target, whose licence excludes the EU, UK and South Korea). stance: the sheet's pose against the human's rest (degrees: upper arms down, legs in), so a limb wraps onto the same limb. regions (strongest rig weight wins; a bone ending in * is every bone starting so): strength (1 wraps fully, 0 only follows its surroundings), inset (m, under the target's surface, where garments are eased out again) and rigid (the head: it moves as a whole, by the mean move to its matches, so the face made after the fit keeps its shape; its size is proportions.head.scale). rounds: smoothing passes of the move field per round; maxDistance (m) and minFacing (cosine) refuse a nearest point on another limb. The values are decided by the agent on 2026-11-19 against house-likeness.ts (brief: slice 2c2 evidence), owner's review pending (open decision 10).

face.$comment: The stylised face (decided by the agent on 2026-11-18, the owner away, for the owner to review; decision 7 of docs/features/directed-performance.md), drawn from the clay sheets: lengths in metres, angles in degrees unless named.

skinUnits.$comment: The faceunits01 units kept on the skin, with their gains (mouthSmile moves only the skin round the authored mouth: see mouth.smileSkin); every other face shape is authored on the parts below.

jawMask.$comment: The jaw units fade out from `from` below the mouth up to `to` below it, so they move the chin and leave the mouth to the mouth's own shapes.

smooth.$comment: The front of the face as a depth map on a grid of `grid` cells (m), halfWidth either side of the midline and from `above` the eyes to `below` them: holes up to about twice `holes` across filled, bumps up to about twice `bumps` across taken off (morphological windows of 2·round(x/grid)+1 cells), blurred by sigma; applied in the `core` ellipse about the eyes' midline, `centre` below eye height, fading out from `fade` of it. A vertex within `tolerance` of the front surface goes onto the smoothed one, one further behind keeps its depth less that. Only head vertices in front of y frontOf move.

eyes.$comment: Each eye's centre `x` from the midline at eye height, its radius, its centre `depth` eye radii behind the smoothed skin; the pupil and iris as angles (radians) from the forward pole, the iris's outer `limbus` of it a darker rim; the glint a disc of `size` eye radii, `off` eye radii from the centre, toward (x, -1, z).

lids.$comment: Shells about each eye (radius in eye radii), `columns` across from -extent to extent, the opening's corners at -corner (inner) and corner (outer) on a line from `inner` to `outer` degrees, the frame turned `yaw` degrees outward; each lid's edge `open` degrees from that line at the middle, falling to the corners as (1 - (u/corner)^2)^power, the lid's `rows` spread from the edge to `back`; where the skin is in front of the shell the lid lies on it (`lift` m in front), the two meeting in a fillet of `fillet` (m). The upper lid's first row is the dark lash line, `lash` degrees thick, `lashInner` of that at the inner corner and full from `lashFull` of the way across, running past the outer corner as a wing that rises wingRise degrees. shapes: the openings [upper, lower] each shape moves to (null: that lid stays; below 0: across the corners' line onto the other lid's edge). A shape's targets go out along their radius as far as needed for every vertex's straight path to stay `clear` eye radii from the centre; so does every mix of the `mixShapes` at the `mixWeights` (over mixPasses rounds), because a mix only adds the shapes' moves. Each lid's first row is its dark line (`lash` degrees deep), the lower lid's a thin one. From `hold` to `settle` degrees behind its edge a lid leaves the shell for the skin behind it, never nearer the eye's centre than `over` eye radii. The upper lash runs `wing` (in u) past the outer corner, rising wingRise degrees. Past the inner corner the lash lines end within `tail`.

brows.$comment: In eye radii from the eye centre: x from the inner to the outer end, the lower edge at the inner end, its rise toward the outer end, the arch (highest where t^peak is a half), the thickness, tapering toward the outer end as 1 - taper·t^taperPower and rounded at the inner end (`blunt` of it there, full from `round` of the way along); lift (m) in front of the face; segments along and rows across.

browShapes.$comment: Moves (m) in the face's plane, then back onto the skin: browDown lowers the inner end by downInner and the outer by downOuter and draws it in by downIn; browInnerUp raises the inner end and draws it out; browOuterUp raises the outer end.

nose.$comment: The MPFB nose, kept through the smoothing (`keep` of it) in an ellipse about `centre` (m) above its tip, halfWidth across, `above` and `below` that centre, fading out from `fade` of it.

mouth.$comment: `columns` across, halfWidth across, `raise` above the mouth corners the faceunits find, the corners `droop` below the middle. The dark line: thick at the middle (the corners keep `corner` of it), lift in front of the skin. lips: the upper and lower lips' heights at the middle, falling to the corners as (1 - s^2)^power, the upper one notched at the middle by `bow` over bowWidth; each lip is a rounded roll: `profile` lists its rows from the line outward as [share of the way to the outer edge, share of upperOut / lowerOut in front of the skin], its outer edge `edge` in front; the lips end at `reach` of the half width and keep `floor` of their height there, and the opening ends at `openReach` of it, so a corner is a closed, rounded pocket of lip. roof: how far up under the upper lip (a share of its height) the inside's hidden top row lies.

smileSkin.$comment: The smile unit on the skin (cheeks, the fold from nose to mouth corner) fades in from `from` to `to` of an ellipse round the mouth: the half width across, `tall` (m) up and down. It fades out again toward the eyes, from eyeFrom to eyeTo (m) below eye height, so the cheek does not rise in front of the sockets.

toothGaps.$comment: The columns at the teeth's edges, each line's half width as a share of a column, where it starts (`from`, a share of the tooth's height from the gum: a notch at the biting edge, not a line over the whole tooth), and its lift (m) in front of the teeth.

patch.$comment: A strip of skin over the slit MPFB leaves at the mouth: half-width in mouth half-widths, half-height and depth behind the skin (m; below zero is in front of it), columns and rows.

mouthShapes.$comment: Moves (m) of the mouth's edges in the face's plane unless named. smile: the corners up and out, the upper edge's middle up by midUp, the middle open, the teeth row dropping `teeth` (a fraction) of the way, the opening keeping its height toward the corners as `round` falls below 1, the mouth `lift` forward (depth) halfway out so the cheek's curve stays behind it; frown: the corners down and out; stretch: the corners out and a little down; press: the corners out, the lips thinner, the corners down; lowerDown / upperUp: the lower lip down, the upper up (lowerDownTeeth: the share of that move the lower teeth row follows, so the lip does not bare the row; lipRound: below 1 the lifted lip keeps its height toward the corners); dimple: the corners back into the cheek; funnel: the corners in, the lips apart up and down; pucker: the corners in, the mouth forward (depth) and the lips `open` apart; smile.thin: the share of their height the lips lose in a smile; upperUp / lowerDown move only the lip's edge, so the teeth show; jawMouth: with the jaw open the upper teeth stay level, dropping `teeth` (`teethRound` in a round mouth) of the opening, and the lower teeth row rises `lowTeeth` of it; roll: corners in, the rolled lip thinner and down; shrug: the lower lip up; side: mouthLeft/Right across; jawSide, jawForward (depth) and jawOpen: the mouth following the jaw units. jawMouth: with the open jaw the corners come `in` and `down`, the upper teeth show over `teeth` of the opening and the tongue over `tongue` of it at the middle, across `tongueWide` of the half-width (rounded by tongueRound); the opening keeps its height toward the corners as `round` falls below 1.

mouthMixes.$comment: Mixes whose summed offsets put the mouth behind the skin (B-073). Each mix is a list of parts (shapes moved together); every part takes each of `weights`. The build pushes each shape's mouth forward, column by column, so every sampled mix keeps the mouth `margin` (m) in front of the skin, at the mouth's points and at `faceSamples` (u, v) inside each of its faces, over `passes` rounds of projections (build.py).

socket.$comment: The skin within `rim` (m) of each opening goes back to `behind` eye radii from the eye's centre, easing out over `slope` (m). Past a corner the distance counts `past` times, so the socket ends within the lids' reach; above the opening it counts `above` times, so the skin under the upper lid stays behind the eye where a view from below sees in under the lid's edge.

sheetSRGB.$comment: sRGB read off clay-turnaround.png's front view (lit midtones); `colours` is these in linear.

builds.$comment: Three pre-built bodies (the build trait), each its own wardrobe file (assets/house-base/wardrobe-<build>.glb, every hair style and glasses kind): MPFB macro values over `macro`. Decided by the agent in the owner's absence on 2026-11-18, for review.

garments.$comment: A loose jumper and trousers made from the body's top and trouser faces (painted by bone): each vertex eased out along the body's normal (m; limb = sleeves or trouser legs), the ease tapering to nothing over `taper` (m) from the openings that close on the body (dominant bone named in taperAt), kept under gapShare of the gap to another part (inner thighs, arms by the side), then smoothed (`rounds` of `smooth` passes) and pushed back out to `clear` of the ease from the body; the jumper's hem takes the trouser faces within `hem` (m) of the waist and stays `overTrousers` (m) outside them. The body under both is removed.

cuff.$comment: The sleeve ends stand `ease` (m) off the wrist at the opening (its boundary on the `at` bones, a circle of the opening's mean radius), fading over `taper`, and turn in by one row `hem` (m) long; the body's faces within `skinUnder` (m) of the opening stay as skin under the cuff (B-101).

hang.$comment: The jumper falls from the chest: from `fromKnee` (share of chest to hips) down, the cloth stands off the spine's line as far as it does higher up. Decided by the agent in the owner's absence on 2026-11-18, for review.
Straight legs: from `fromKnee` (share of hip to foot) down, the cloth stands off the leg's line as far as it does higher up. Decided by the agent in the owner's absence on 2026-11-18, for review.

collar.$comment: The jumper's neckline: across the shoulders (|x| under `halfWidth` m, from `below` m under the neck's base up), faces below a plane through the neck's base (raised `raise` m), tilting down to the front by `tilt` (m per m), are jumper; above it, skin.

sleeveEnd.$comment: The sleeve ends: an arm's forearm and hand faces within `band` (m) of a plane across the forearm `back` (m) up from the wrist joint are skin on the hand's side and jumper on the forearm's side, so the cuff ends in a clean ring; the vertices on the line between them move onto the plane (B-101).

cuff.$comment: The trouser hems: faces within `band` (m) of a level plane `raise` (m) above the highest toe vertex are shoe below it and trousers above it, so the hem is straight. Decided by the agent on 2026-11-18 (slice 2c2), owner's review pending.

shoes.$comment: Shoes from the feet's faces, eased and smoothed like the other garments (no opening tapers, so the ease is even), the ease going to nothing on faces turned down (`soleBelow`), so the sole stays on the floor. Decided by the agent on 2026-11-18 (slice 2c2), owner's review pending.

hair.$comment: Hair styles (clay-traits.png): shells cast from the head's centre onto the scalp, `columns` round and `rows` up to `poleRow` degrees, tucked `tuck` (m) under the scalp at the hairline. line: the hairline as [degrees round from the front, degrees up from level]; over the brows it is raised until it sits browMargin (m) above the brows raised all the way (no style crosses the brow line). Thickness (m): sides, top (reached `rise` degrees above the hairline), back, a front volume over frontWidth degrees; locks ripple the thickness (ridges: n round, swept; bumps: n round by m up). A curtain hangs from the hairline from `from` degrees round (ramping over `ramp`), to an end per angle [degrees, landmark, offset m], `clear` (m) outside the body, flaring and waving; below the chin it is carried by the chest. Decided by the agent in the owner's absence on 2026-11-18, for review.

glasses.$comment: Frames (no lenses) in units of `unit` (m) from a point `anchor` units behind the skin before each eye: `forward` in front, `out` sideways, `drop` down; rims as superellipses width x height with an exponent (2 round, higher squarer), tops below the brows' lower edge; a tube of radius `tube` (m); the bridge from each rim's point bridgeAt (share of the rim round from the outer side) over the nose; temples from templeAt, out past the head's side (ears included) by templeClear (m), back to earBack (m) behind the head's centre, hooking down. Colour sRGB. Decided by the agent in the owner's absence on 2026-11-18, for review.

defaultLook.$comment: The look public/gltf/models/house-base.glb is dressed in (a card, see packages/avatar-look). Decided by the agent in the owner's absence on 2026-11-18, for review.
